layers.name: Desktop Shell
responsibilities: Secure vault using OS Keychain (keyring/stronghold) for BYOK API keys
Process manager to start/stop FastAPI sidecar
Settings UI: license key entry, toggle cloak on/off, provider selection

layers.name: Security Engine
responsibilities: PII redaction and secret tokenization (RAM only)
Dynamic routing to OpenAI/Anthropic/Perplexity/Gemini/Ollama via provider registry
Fetch API keys from OS Keychain at request time; never persist in files
Licensing and smart renewal via Lemon Squeezy

layers.name: Access Points
responsibilities: Extension intercepts chat inputs, sends to /redact for cleaning, forwards to site
IDE traffic routed to localhost proxy; redaction + key injection handled centrally

data_flow: Extension/IDE sends request to http://127.0.0.1:8080/redact or passthrough endpoint
Security Engine redacts PII/secrets, tokenizes, and retrieves provider API key from Keychain
Security Engine forwards scrubbed request + key to the appropriate provider
Response returned, tokens restored, delivered back to Extension/IDE
principles: Strict BYOK: API keys only in memory, loaded from keychain, never written to disk or logs
Local-first: server binds to localhost only; no content leaves the machine unredacted
Modular: providers pluggable; UI/Engine/Access layers decoupled
